name: Bitwarden
tagline: Open source, independently audited, free tier that's genuinely complete
highlights: Fully open source — anyone can audit the code, and Cure53 has (2022 audit)
Free tier includes unlimited vault items and all core features
Self-hosting option available for users who want complete data control
verdict: The best password manager for most people — open source, audited, and free tier covers everything you need.
bestFor: Anyone who wants the most transparent, auditable password manager at the lowest cost

name: 1Password
tagline: Best UX in the category — Secret Key architecture, no free tier
highlights: Secret Key architecture: your data is encrypted with a key that never leaves your device
Best-in-class browser integration and autofill across all platforms
Never been breached in over 15 years of operation
verdict: The best UX and strongest security architecture — worth the price if you value a polished experience.
bestFor: Teams, families, and users who want the most polished experience and don't mind paying

name: Dashlane
tagline: Polished UI with built-in VPN and dark web monitoring — most expensive option
highlights: Built-in VPN (Hotspot Shield) and dark web monitoring included in premium
Password health score gives you a clear view of weak or reused passwords
verdict: Good product, but significantly overpriced compared to Bitwarden and 1Password for equivalent security.
bestFor: Users who want dark web monitoring and a built-in VPN bundled with their password manager

name: NordPass
tagline: From the team behind NordVPN — XChaCha20 encryption, free tier available
highlights: XChaCha20 encryption — more modern algorithm than the AES-256 used by most competitors
Independent security audit completed by Cure53
Free tier available with basic vault features
verdict: Decent mid-tier option, but Bitwarden offers more transparency at a lower price point.
bestFor: Existing NordVPN subscribers who want a bundled security solution

name: Keeper
tagline: Enterprise-grade security with excellent recovery options — SOC 2 certified
highlights: FIDO2 hardware key support and biometric authentication on all platforms
SOC 2 Type 2 and ISO 27001 certified — strongest compliance credentials in the category
BreachWatch dark web monitoring available as an add-on
verdict: Enterprise-focused with excellent 2FA support, but closed source and more expensive than Bitwarden.
bestFor: Business users or individuals who need enterprise compliance features and extensive 2FA options
